description: FP16 GEMM benchmark using cuBLAS (NVIDIA) or rocBLAS (AMD). Computes C = alpha * A * B + beta * C where A is M×K, B is K×N, C is M×N (row-major, FP16/__half). Leverages Tensor Cores when available. Reports TFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K; controls total FLOP count (2*M*N*K)

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup iterations before timing

non_scaling_params.name: iters
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
